title.narrative: Promoting energy efficient cook stoves in micro and small-scale food processing industries

description.narrative: Request for intervention initiated by the national GEF operational Focal Point in Chad following the ECOWAS-GFSE-GEF-UNIDO High Level Forum #Towards Sustainable Energy For All in West Africa. Paving the Way through Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency# held in Accra, Ghana in October 29-31, 2012. The project is to promote energy efficient cook stoves in traditional agro-food processing industries.
